اسحب السوستة 
 ذات القطر الصغير ومعه 
Spring cab

يتم 
 اخراج السوستة الكبيرة وفك الكوبلنج ما بين عامود البلف وعامود 
 الاسطوانة الكبيرة

يتم 
 تركيب التجهيزات المذكورة فى الخطوة رقم (3) وربط الفتيل حتى 
 يصل الى العامود السفلى للبلف

فك 
 الصامولة والطرق الخفيف على الفتيل مما يؤدى الى نزول العامود 
 بقلب البلف

يتم 
 تكرار الخطوتين السابقتين مع رش الاسبراى حتى يسهل اخراج البلف

نظف 
 الاجزاء المفكوكة وتغيير التالف منها

يتم 
 البدء فى تجميع البلف وذلك بفك الكوبلنج ورفع التجهيزة

يتم 
 النزول بالاسطوانة الكبيرة وتركيب الكوبلنج

يتم النزول بالسوستة الكبيرة ثم النزول 
 بالاسطوانة الصغيرة ثم السوستة الصغيرة وعليها الغطاء الخاصة 
 بها 
Spring Cab

ادهن 
 فلانشة الجسم الثابت للبلف بالميلكوت الحرارى ثم وضع الغطاء 
 وربط مسامير البلف

يتم قياس طول مسمار الضبط
Regulating Bolt 
 والتأكد من القيم السابقة له

يتم 
 تركيب فلانشة ماسورة خط الزيت (دخول - رجوع)

يتم 
 تشغيل طلمبة الزيت للتأكد من عدم وجود اى تهريبات فى خطوط 
 الزيت

الجدول التالى يبين اخذ

Issued to:
Assiut Steam
3 x 30 MW

The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Ahmed 
Sayed Hussein, 
tested by Eng. Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by 
Eng. Abdel Azim Hagras, 
General Manager, 
and endorsed by 
Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, 
Head of the Stations 
Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator, 
and Head of 
the Inspection and Quality Control Sector 
at the Upper Egypt 
Electricity Production Company

Ensure that the unit to be 
 worked on is isolated

An approved work order must be issued by the competent 
 authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health 
 category card

Record 
 the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories

Fence off the work area of the equipment and place the appropriate 
 warning signs

Workers must wear 
 occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out 
 the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
A set of open-end wrenches and ring wrenches, sizes 10 to 36 mm
Vernier caliper, depth gauge and ratchet

A special fixture consisting of a
 Disk 
 with a stud with two nuts ending in a coupling groove similar to the original valve stem

Rust-removing spray cans 
WD40 
 and fine sandpaper

Remove 
 the flange of the oil inlet and outlet line pipes from the valve and the oil 
 drains

Measure the length of 
 the adjusting screw 
Regulating 
Bolt 
 to determine the spring force

Remove 
 the bolts of the upper half of the upper valve and lift it

Pull out the small-diameter spring together with the 
Spring cap

The large spring is removed and the coupling between the valve stem and the large 
 cylinder stem is dismantled

The fixtures mentioned in step (3) are installed and the stud is tightened until 
 it reaches the lower stem of the valve

Loosen 
 the nut and tap the stud lightly, which causes the stem to go down 
 inside the valve

The 
 previous two steps are repeated, spraying the spray until the valve is easy to remove

Clean 
 the dismantled parts and replace the damaged ones
Reassembly of the valve is started by dismantling the coupling and lifting the fixture
The large cylinder is lowered and the coupling is installed

The large spring is lowered, then the small cylinder is lowered, then the small spring with its 
 cover 
Spring cap

Coat 
 the flange of the fixed valve body with heat-resistant Molykote, then place the cover 
 and tighten the valve bolts

Measure the length of the adjusting screw
Regulating Bolt 
 and verify its previous values

Install 
 the flange of the oil line pipe (inlet - return)

Run 
 the oil pump to ensure there are no leaks in the oil 
 lines
The following table shows the readings taken after operation
